messages:
Iris: Quick standup about the 'Advisor' eval-triggered recommendations pilot. Need final scope and owners.
Noah: High-level asks from customers: make recommendations safe, explainable, and reversible. They want low-friction previews.
Pat: Can we enumerate the recommendation types? My suggestion: batching tunables, KV/prefix cache suggestions, quantization profiles, and model-variant suggestions for cost vs perf.
Jun: +1. Also add a router-level policy suggestion for routing lower-priority traffic to cheaper variants.
Iris: Proposed acceptance bullets: 
- Trigger sources: scheduled evals, live telemetry alerts, manual tests
- Triggers defined: quality_delta_pct (default 6%), embed_shift_score (>0.12), hallucination_rate_delta (abs >2.5%)
- Each rec must include: confidence label (high/med/low), expected econ delta (tokens/1000), estimated latency impact (95p), and holdout eval snapshot id
- Safety: quant recs must pass a holdout regression check (max 2% nominal drop on golden set) and be flagged for tenant policy overrides
- Rollout policy: internal alpha (team services) -> partner customers (opt-in) -> opt-out GA
Noah: From infra: we need (a) an eval webhook that emits normalized trigger events, (b) a cost estimator microservice, (c) an apply API that supports dry-run and rollback.
Pat: UX: preview card in Console with diff view, econ estimate, and a one-click 'Queue change' button (not auto-apply). For Dedicated/Private, queue creates a change request for ops to approve.
Jun: Ops note: some tenants disallow quantization and some disallow remote config. Add tenant policy check early in pipeline and surface why a rec was blocked.
Iris: Pilot gating criteria draft: 
- Internal alpha: run on 5 services for 10 days, no critical regressions and <1% auto-rollback rate
- Partner pilot: 2 customers, documented econ improvement >=8% and at least one applied change per customer during pilot
- Monitoring: dashboards for false positives, rec acceptance rate, rollback triggers, and customer opt-outs
Noah: Rollback automation idea: apply changes behind a toggle that monitors error rates + latency; auto-revert if error rate increases by threshold or 95p latency regresses >20% for 10m.
Pat: For quantization recommendations please include an estimated uncertainty band (e.g., expected accuracy loss 0.5-1.8%) and attach the exact eval sampling used. That will help CS justify changes to customers.
Jun: Also recommend we surface a simple remediation suggestion in the preview (e.g., reduce batch size back to N or revert to FP16).
ops-bot: infra: eval webhook deployed to staging at 3599999122 :white_check_mark:
Iris: Owners: Pat -> UX/preview + pilot criteria doc (due Wed). Noah -> eval webhook + cost estimator APIs (PR by Tue). Jun -> ops runbook + tenant policy checks (draft by Thu). I'll handle acceptance signoff and schedules.
Noah: Timeline sanity check: if infra delivers APIs by next Tue we can spin a 2-week internal alpha starting the following Monday. Partner pilot in 3 weeks.
Pat: I'll include canned messaging for CS and a short FAQ for customers explaining triggers, how to opt-out, and rollback behavior.
Iris: Final note: keep recommendations read-only by default for the first two pilots. No automatic application until confidence metrics hit 'high' and partner opts in.
Jun: Agreed. Also log every preview shown to a customer for audit.
Iris: OK I'll create the ticket on the Optimize board and book a sync Friday 9am to walk through the acceptance doc.
Pat: good plan :thumbsup:
Noah: fine with that
Jun: see you Friday
